thread.title: Stock Market, Dow Jones Surge; Tesla Stock Hits Buy| Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market, Dow Jones Surge; Tesla Stock Hits Buy| Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes were paring back early gains in today's stock market , with the S&P 500, the Dow Jones industrials and the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite all fight to hold gains near 1%. The Dow Jones industrial average gained about 300 points amid optimism on progress between the United States and China.
Apple ( AAPL ) gave up early gains. Apple stock is a key member of the Dow Jones, S&P 500 index and Nasdaq composite. Meanwhile, Tesla ( TSLA ) battled to regain a recent buy point. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X The Dow Jones industrials and the S&P 500 index advanced 1.1% and 1.2%, respectively. The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite gained 1.1%. With the recent strong downside pressure on the stock market, investors should be focusing on stocks that are holding up the best amid the volatile action. On Monday, the Dow Jones industrials and the S&P 500 undercut their correction lows before rebounding.
Stock Market Earnings: Dave & Buster's Due Dave & Buster's ( PLAY ) is set to report after the stock market close Tuesday. Analysts expect the restaurant-arcade chain to earn 21 cents per share on revenue of $274 million.
Shares touched their 200-day line Monday before rebounding. The stock is creating a potential double-base formation with a 61.85 buy point.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Automakers Rise, As Tesla Stock Fights To Reclaim Buy Point U.S. automakers rallied early Tuesday after Bloomberg reported that China is moving toward cutting tariffs on U.S.-made cars. The proposal to cut tariffs from 40% to 15% has been submitted to China's cabinet for review.
Ford ( F ) and General Motors ( GM ) advanced 2% and 3%, respectively. Both automakers are set to snap four-day losing streaks that saw them give up their respective 50-day line support levels.
Meanwhile, stock leader Tesla stock reversed early gains and slipped 0.2%, dipping back below a cup with handle's 366.85 buy point in morning trade after regaining the buy point at the stock market open.
Tesla stock tried to break out past the entry on Friday after an analyst upgrade, but the breakout faded amid the stock market rout. Despite the stock market volatility, the stock's relative strength line continues to make new highs, a bullish technical metric.
Did Apple Stock Bottom? Or Is there More Room To Fall? Apple stock gave up solid gains to fall 1% in morning trade Tuesday, complicating Monday's bullish reversal.
At Monday's low, Apple stock declined as much as 3.1% to 163.33. The stock's fall put the stock 30% off its 52-week high before rebounding. By the stock market close, the stock has reversed the entirety of those losses to gain 0.7% in heavy volume. The positive close created a bullish upside reversal day. The stock's previous upside reversal day on Nov. 26 led to an 8.6% gain off its lows in just six trading sessions. Those gains proved to be short-lived, as the sellers in the stock market regained control.
Despite the constructive technical action, Apple stock is still well-below its 50- and 200-day moving average lines and well away from any potential buy point. During the stock's fall, the stock's RS line took a substantial hit, and institutions fled the stock. According to the IBD Stock Checkup , Apple stock has a lowest-possible E Accumulation/Distribution Rating .
IBD 50 Stocks: Dow Jones Stock Intel Advances Among the leading growth stocks , Dow Jones stock Intel ( INTC ) moved up with solid gains for a second straight day, gaining more than 2%. The stock is trying to find support at its 50-day line, as it shapes the right side of a potential base.
On the downside, Horizon Pharma ( HZNP ) lost 2%, falling for a fifth straight trading day. The stock is trying to find support near its 50-day after triggering a sell signal from a 21.35 buy point.
